direction_values.undirected: no drawing evidence; shown without an arrow
direction_values.conflict: evidence disagrees; shown without an arrow

summary.keys_note: Every PID2Graph OPEN100 graphml is edgedefault="undirected"; its arrow nodes have a position and no orientation. Direction accuracy can't be scored against the keys.
summary.confidence_source: blind spot check: the readers listed read crops of the original drawing with A/B outlined. agreement = share of decided readings (readers pooled) that agree with the inferred direction; confidence = the lower end of its 95% Wilson interval. UNCLEAR readings are not counted either way. Not an answer key.
